nodes.label: Binary U-Net Model (2 classes: background + leaf)
nodes.rationale: Instance labels (leaf 1,2,3,...) are not semantically consistent across images, so a standard U-Net cannot learn them as classes; converting to binary foreground-vs-background is what standard U-Net handles well.
nodes.norm_label: binary u-net model (2 classes: background + leaf)

nodes.label: BinaryLeafDataset
nodes.rationale: Converts instance masks (0..27) to binary on-the-fly with (mask > 0) so original mask files on disk are never modified; uses NEAREST resize to preserve label integrity.

nodes.label: Weighted BCE + Dice Combined Loss
nodes.rationale: BCE provides pixel-level gradient signal while Dice provides region-level overlap optimization; together they produce smooth, complete leaf masks.

nodes.label: Inverse Frequency Class Weighting
nodes.rationale: With >99% background pixels unweighted BCE learns to predict background everywhere; weight = total/(2*n_class) clamped to [0.3, 3.0] makes misclassifying a leaf pixel cost ~10x more.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Approach (Binary Segmentation + Watershed)
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 gives pixel-wise background/leaf mask; Stage 2 Watershed separates overlapping leaves into instance labels 1..N.

nodes.label: Marker Generation
nodes.rationale: Threshold at 40% of max distance then connected components gives one seed per leaf; lower to 25% for heavier overlap.

nodes.label: Mixed Precision Training (AMP)
nodes.rationale: Float16 softmax+CrossEntropy can overflow to NaN, so the loop checks gradients before stepping and skips problematic batches.

nodes.label: Dice-Based Early Stopping & Model Selection
nodes.rationale: IoU is the final metric of interest but Dice is more stable for small foreground regions during training; best_dice initialized to -1.0 so epoch 1 always saves.

nodes.label: Instance vs Semantic Segmentation
nodes.rationale: Leaf instance IDs are arbitrary per image so U-Net cannot treat them as semantic classes; binary conversion avoids the instance segmentation requirement.

nodes.norm_label: penjelasan model u-net standar (standard u-net deep dive)

nodes.label: UNet Assembly Class
nodes.rationale: Encoder/decoder symmetry with factor = 2 if bilinear else 1 to save memory at the bottleneck when using bilinear upsampling.

nodes.label: DoubleConv
nodes.rationale: Two conv(3x3)+BN+ReLU blocks; bias=False because BatchNorm already provides the shift; first conv expands representation, second refines non-linearly.

nodes.label: Up (Decoder Block)
nodes.rationale: Padding-aligned concat with skip features; bilinear mode uses 1x1 conv to reduce channels, transposed mode learns the upsampling kernel.

nodes.label: OutConv
nodes.rationale: 1x1 convolution maps channels to n_classes without changing resolution; no activation since loss functions handle softmax internally.

nodes.label: Skip Connections
nodes.rationale: Connect encoder features to decoder at the same resolution to preserve spatial detail lost during downsampling.

nodes.label: Bilinear vs Transposed Conv Upsampling
nodes.rationale: Bilinear is deterministic and parameter-light but not learned; transposed conv learns upsampling but can produce checkerboard artifacts.

nodes.label: Gradient Checkpointing (use_checkpointing)
nodes.rationale: Trade-off: ~20-30% more compute but ~40-50% less GPU memory by recomputing forward activations during backward.

nodes.label: Dice Loss / dice_coeff
nodes.rationale: Directly optimizes overlap so it is robust to class imbalance, but gradients are small when overlap is small early in training.

nodes.label: Combined Loss (Weighted BCE + Dice)
nodes.rationale: Best of both worlds: BCE stable per-pixel signal, Dice handles imbalance; class weights are inverse-frequency clamped to [0.3, 3.0].

nodes.label: Mixed Precision Training (AMP)
nodes.rationale: FP16 forward/activations cut memory ~50% and boost throughput ~1.5-2x via Tensor Cores; GradScaler provides numerical stability.

nodes.label: BinaryLeafDataset
nodes.rationale: Wrapper converting multi-class masks (0-27) to binary (0=bg, 1=leaf) via (mask > 0).astype(int64); BICUBIC image resize, NEAREST mask resize.

nodes.label: Binary Metrics (IoU & Dice)
nodes.rationale: Dice = 2*IoU/(1+IoU) so Dice is always >= IoU; IoU is the final metric of interest.

nodes.label: RMSprop + ReduceLROnPlateau Config
nodes.rationale: RMSprop lr=1e-5 momentum=0.999 weight_decay=1e-8 matches original U-Net paper; low LR for transfer-learning context; plateau scheduler drops LR when Dice plateaus.

nodes.label: Enhanced U-Net
nodes.rationale: Upgrade path from standard U-Net: add Attention Gates in Up blocks, residual DoubleConv, deep supervision, dropout.
